reasons.name: Punch First
reasons.why: Up +12.8 pp mainly because Kha'Zix, Voidreaver decks arrived (6.2% of the field) and 83% of them play it (+5.2 pp); Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman decks grew from 8.3% to 13% of the field and play it in 100% of lists (+5.1 pp). Together these account for +10.2 pp of the +12.8 pp.
reasons.postureWhy: n/a (this game has no appeal list, so collector posture is not judged; demand comes from usage change alone).

reasons.name: Sabotage
reasons.why: Up +10.4 pp mainly because Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman lists added it (50% → 85% of those lists, deck at 13% of the field) (+7.2 pp); Kha'Zix, Voidreaver decks arrived (6.2% of the field) and 100% of them play it (+6.2 pp). Together these add +13.4 pp; other decks moved the other way, netting +10.4 pp.
